entries.grounds: Mutant confirmed at L776 (mutant_view [41]): 'e.strerror or e' -> 'e.strerror and e'. Original interpolates strerror when truthy else the exception; mutant interpolates the exception (str(e)='[Errno 13] Permission denied: <path>') when strerror is truthy else strerror (and on a falsy/None strerror renders 'None' or ''). For a typical PermissionError both convey the same error and path; the exception TYPE NAME 'PermissionError' (from type(e).__name__, independent of this swap), the remedy and the assurance are untouched. Measured SURVIVED (51 OK): the kill test asserts 'PermissionError' + 'RUN.json' + code — all preserved. Not EQUIVALENT (strerror != str(e); falsy strerror renders differently), but observable only in which rendering of the same OSError is shown.
exceptions_checked: observable detail-rendering change, so not EQUIVALENT; no consumer/contract/doc depends on whether strerror or str(e) is shown, and the UNREADABLE code + type name + guidance are preserved
entries.note: Author grounds hold; not EQUIVALENT correctly withheld; measurement reproduced (51 OK).

notes: Skeptic verification of W2-bundle_cli-6 (8 NEW survivors on bundle_cli.py::_record; carried empty). Every mutant re-confirmed with mutant_view.py (line, function, diff) and all 8 re-measured: baseline 51 OK, each mutant 51 OK == SURVIVED, reproducing the author and the campaign. All 8 are operator-facing refusal-message-string mutations inside JournalRefused(code, message) raises; none changes the error code (first arg), control flow, or the returned (rec, recorded). The body's only reader is the operator via print(f'refused: {e}') at bundle_cli.py:1079 (the single BundleError handler in main(); verified there is exactly one 'refused: {e}' print and _record's JournalRefused reaches it through continue_from at L899); run.py:243's 'refused:' check is on a git subprocess's stderr, not this body. All 6 AUDITED verdicts CONFIRMED: 24/30 drop only an un-pinned remedy/reason-tag while code + 'no run record' + file names survive (grep found the remedy idiom is asserted by no test); 38/39 drop a connective/separator with type name + remedy + assurance preserved ('PermissionError' survives as a substring); 41 swaps which rendering of the same OSError is shown (type name independent); 42 changes a join separator observable only when two records are simultaneously cut. Both REFUTED (test-owed) verdicts CONFIRMED: 33 empties the ENTIRE operator sentence (bare code+path) and 40 deletes the 'nothing was written / run never modified' safety assurance, each on a path whose SIBLING (not-text L768-771; journal-unreadable _journal L847-850) deliberately pins the analogous text — real symmetric coverage gaps. Verified no unregistered test kills 33 or 40: the only RUN.json chmod in tests/ is pw L256 (the registered guard), and the only valid-JSON-non-dict RUN.json writers that are not the registered guard (defects_verify L389 -> lineage_account; pw_lineage_unread L553 -> child record) do not reach _record's L783; the directory-unreadable test (pw L190) short-circuits in lineage.continued_by before _record. Minor cite corrections recorded on 33 (verify.py's message is 'of format', not '(a JSON object)') and 40 (lineage.continued_by call site is L886). Both refutation sketches are runnable, mirror an existing sibling test, and were verified to target exactly the strings the mutants empty. No code or tests changed; closure-evidence not modified.
